name: Crisis consultancy or ransom-response payments without documentation
description: Payments to intermediaries described as negotiators or consultants with limited contracts or oversight.
fp: Professional crisis response firms exist and are lawful.

sources.text: FATF, Organised Maritime Piracy and Related Kidnapping for Ransom (2011)
UN Security Council Resolution 2133 (2014) on kidnapping for ransom by terrorist groups
